_comment: A ratchet on Rosalind answer coverage, enforced by scripts/verify-packs.mjs,
which CI runs before every other pack gate.
Without it a pack could quietly stop asserting its answers -- flip problems to
network, drop files, or mark them unasserted -- and every gate below would stay
green while checking less. Withholding pack source from the website deploy
(pack.toml `publish_source`) deliberately does not touch any of these numbers.
Raise a floor when a pack gains coverage. Never lower one to make a build pass:
that is the exact failure this file exists to catch.
